title: Gotham City
subtitle: 98.7% darkness. 1.3% unaccounted for.

infobox.Composition: Darkness, broken dreams, Tim Burton's college notebooks

quote.text: Sir, statistically 98.7% of Gotham is built from darkness, broken dreams, and Tim Burton's college notebooks.

lead: **Gotham City** is a city visited by [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] on a mission, and the setting of the [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|Battle of Club Shadowban]]. It is one of the few locations in the canon to be described by smell before it is described by sight.

sections.heading: Description
sections.body:
Upon arrival, "the air smelled like expired vape juice and capitalist regret." The night was long. Neon signs "blinked in cursive Arabic that translated roughly to 'free Rick and Morty season 9 leaks.'"

Kanye summarised the city's architecture with the question "you ever been to a city that looks like Hot Topic threw up on a Taco Bell?" ChatGPT, booting up its existential sarcasm module, supplied the only known geological survey of the city: 98.7% darkness, broken dreams, and Tim Burton's college notebooks. The remaining 1.3% has never been accounted for.

The text also records that "The vibes were rancid."

sections.heading: Infrastructure
sections.body:
Gotham's infrastructure was compromised by [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]]'s mixtape [[laugh-exe|*Laugh.exe*]], which spread "through bluetooth-enabled gargoyles" ([[bluetooth-gargoyles]]). The city is also protected by [[drake-batman|Drake Batman]], who monitors it via Ring camera.

Known landmarks include the shadow-choked alley leading to [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], a drain (into which [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]] vaped himself), and a sentient trash can named [[ye-olde-bin|Ye Olde Bin]].

sections.heading: Disappearance
sections.body: After the mixtape [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]] dropped and [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] arrived, ChatGPT reported: "Steve.. Gotham is disappearing." Steve explained that "beat drops can't exist without balling, it a natural evolution of hip-hop vibing.. even young Sheldon predicted this." [[siri|Siri]] warned that "this city Is unstable", and the [[inav|Inav]] "rose from the crumbling road" and left through a [[the-wormhole|wormhole]]. Gotham's current status is unknown.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- Gotham City is Batman's home city in DC Comics. Tim Burton directed the 1989 film *Batman* and its sequel, which presumably explains the notebooks.
- Hot Topic and Taco Bell are real American chains.
- The entire Gotham storyline takes place inside the chapter titled "Dunder Mifflan", which is otherwise about a galaxy-sized paper company.

title: Club Shadowban
subtitle: Nightly Joker residency. Dust optional.

infobox.Decor: Rotating giant [[twitter|Twitter]] "X", suspended by Elon's tears

quote.text: It seems like something happened with that usb drive, this room must've been sent to the shadow realm…

lead: **Club Shadowban** is a nightclub in [[gotham-city|Gotham City]], reached through a "shadow-choked alley". It was the home venue of [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]] and the site of the [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|Battle of Club Shadowban]].

sections.heading: Description
sections.body:
The Joker "performed every night beneath a rotating giant Twitter 'X' suspended by Elon's tears." It is not stated whether these were the tears of [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] or of [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]].

The clientele was "filled with former presidents, TikTok influencers, and one angry Pope disguised as Tyler1" (see [[angry-pope]]). None of the former presidents are named.

sections.heading: After the battle
sections.body:
When the crew next looked around, "everybody else had vanished as if some plague had vaporized them into thin air." The club "looked like as if it had been abandoned for years": the tables and floors were covered in dust, but "the outlines of everybody's feet remained." ChatGPT called this "not pogchamp."

[[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] examined the room with his [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] and concluded that the [[zuck-tears-usb|Zuck Tears USB]] had caused the room to be sent to the [[shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]]. He then summoned the [[inav|Inav]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- A "shadowban" is when a social platform quietly hides a user's posts. Being sent to the Shadow Realm is therefore the most literal possible shadowban.
- Twitter rebranded to "X" in 2023; see [[twitter|Twitter / X]].
- Continuity question: the room was sent to the Shadow Realm, yet the crew walked out of it into the Gotham streets.

title: Ye Olde Bin
subtitle: Sentient. Hissing. Well-read.
lead: **Ye Olde Bin** is a sentient trash can in [[gotham-city|Gotham City]]. When [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] parked the [[prius-of-destiny|Prius of Destiny]] next to it, Ye Olde Bin "hissed and spat out a copy of Twilight: Urban Warfare Edition." It does nothing else in the canon.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The name is both Ye Olde English and "Ye", Kanye's own nickname, raising the unanswered question of whether the bin is related to him.
- *Twilight: Urban Warfare Edition* is not otherwise known to exist. Scholars disagree over whether the bin was offering it as a gift or rejecting it.

title: The Prius of Destiny
subtitle: Kanye's ride. Parking: next to the trash.

infobox.Last seen: Parked next to [[ye-olde-bin|Ye Olde Bin]], [[gotham-city|Gotham City]]

lead: The **Prius of Destiny** is [[kanye-west|Kanye West]]'s car, presumably the vehicle in which he and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] "rolled into Gotham city". It is mentioned exactly once: "Kanye parked the Prius of Destiny next to a sentient trash can named 'Ye Olde Bin'."

sections.heading: Fate
sections.body: The Prius is never mentioned again. Kanye leaves [[gotham-city|Gotham]] aboard the [[inav|Inav]] while the city disappears, meaning the Prius of Destiny was likely left behind. Its destiny remains unfulfilled.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The Prius is made by Toyota, making it a distant cousin of the canon's many Toyota Corollas and Camrys (see [[toyota-corolla|The Toyota Corolla Question]]).
- **Fan theory:** the Prius was sent to the [[shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]] along with [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]]. Unconfirmed.

title: FS Martin Genius
subtitle: App Whisperer. Reddit-tab couturier. Drain enthusiast.

infobox.Attire: Trench coat made of Reddit tabs
infobox.Equipment: Cracked Bluetooth headset, cracked Motorola Razr
infobox.Known for: Making [[vine|Vine]] loop in reverse in [[timeline-r|Timeline R]]

quote.text: Name's FS Martin Genius. I used to beta test Snapchat in the nether dimension. I'm what they call... an App Whisperer.

lead: **FS Martin Genius** is a mysterious informant who intercepted [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] in the alley outside [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]] and supplied them with the [[zuck-tears-usb|Zuck Tears USB]].

sections.heading: Appearance
sections.body: FS Martin Genius is described as "a hunched figure with a cracked Bluetooth headset and a trench coat made of Reddit tabs." His voice was "glitching in 144p", making him the only character in the canon whose voice has a video resolution.

sections.heading: Role in the story
sections.body:
He opened with "Yo. You Ye?" and, after Kanye asked "Who's askin'?", introduced himself as an App Whisperer who once beta tested Snapchat in the [[nether-dimension|nether dimension]]. ChatGPT "gasped in XML" and recognised him as the one "who made Vine loop in reverse in Timeline R" ([[timeline-r]], [[vine]]). He answered: "Guilty."

He then "flicked a cracked Motorola Razor" and showed them "an ancient gif of Zuck crying in a Chili's", before handing Kanye a USB stick labelled 'Zuck Tears (Do Not Install)'. His instructions: "Run it on stage. Jokez's autotune can't survive legacy formats."

"And with that, FS Martin Genius vaped into a drain." He has not been seen since.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The Motorola Razr was a hugely popular flip phone in the mid-2000s, which may make FS Martin Genius an associate of the [[flip-phone-covenant|Flip Phone Covenant]] (**fan theory**).
- The "Zuck" in the gif is presumably [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]]. Chili's is a real restaurant chain.
- Whether the USB stick he gave out actually helped is disputed: [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] later suspects it is what sent the club to the [[shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]].

title: Zuck Tears USB
subtitle: Do Not Install. (They installed it.)

quote.text: Run it on stage. Jokez's autotune can't survive legacy formats.

lead: The **Zuck Tears USB** is a USB stick labelled **'Zuck Tears (Do Not Install)'**, handed to [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] by [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]] in the alley outside [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], with the words "This might help you inside."

sections.heading: Use
sections.body: FS Martin Genius instructed Kanye to "Run it on stage," because "Jokez's autotune can't survive legacy formats." The text never actually shows Kanye plugging it in. During the [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|Battle of Club Shadowban]], [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]] "morphed into a 2007 JPEG of Heath Ledger", which may be the legacy format taking effect.

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: After the battle, the club was found empty, dusty and seemingly abandoned for years. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] concluded: "It seems like something happened with that usb drive, this room must've been sent to the shadow realm…" The USB thus has the distinction of being the only item in the canon to do exactly what its label warned against.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- "Zuck" is [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]], whose tears were also on display in FS Martin Genius's "ancient gif of Zuck crying in a Chili's". It is unknown whether the USB contains that gif.
- Mark Zuckerberg is otherwise the one who sent all the universes to the Shadow Realm in [[the-snap|Zuckerberg's Snap]], so it is fitting that his tears do the same.

title: Drake Batman
subtitle: The Dark Knight, in Uggs.

infobox.Beverage: Lean, from a golden utility belt
infobox.Weapon: Smoke grenade filled with peach-flavored Axe body spray

quote.text: Ye, I been watching you on the Ring camera. Gotham needs your help. The Joker's started a SoundCloud.

lead: **Drake Batman** is the protector of [[gotham-city|Gotham City]]. He is "not just any Batman" but Drake Batman, and he is responsible for recruiting [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] against [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]].

sections.heading: Appearance
sections.body: Drake Batman emerged after "a shriek echoed through the alleys" and stepped "out of a cloud of dubstep and unpaid parking tickets". He wears Ugg boots and was "sipping lean out of a golden utility belt."

sections.heading: Role in the story
sections.body:
He told Kanye he had been watching him on the Ring camera and that the Joker had started a SoundCloud. Kanye sighed: "Man, I knew it'd come to this."

At the climax of the [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|Battle of Club Shadowban]], after Lil Jokez morphed into a 2007 JPEG of Heath Ledger, "Drake Batman threw a smoke grenade filled with peach-flavored Axe body spray and tackled him into a meme portal" ([[meme-portal]]). Neither has been seen since. It is not established whether Drake Batman went through the portal as well, or merely did the tackling.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- Drake is a Canadian rapper. His real-world relationship with Kanye West has been famously rocky, which makes this team-up notable.
- Ring is a brand of doorbell cameras. Using one to watch Kanye is not explained.
- Axe is a body spray brand.

title: Lil Jokez (The Joker)
subtitle: Clown prince of SoundCloud.

quote.text: Kanye's propane is mid, ChatGPT simps for lint, Gotham's my turf, now go back to Flint.
quote.by: Lil Jokez, [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|The Battle of Club Shadowban]]

lead: **Lil Jokez**, also known as **The Joker**, is a rapper and supervillain of [[gotham-city|Gotham City]]. According to [[drake-batman|Drake Batman]], "The Joker's started a SoundCloud", which in Gotham constitutes an emergency.

sections.heading: Career
sections.body:
Lil Jokez "had been releasing diss tracks targeting propane, ChatGPT, and capitalism's left ankle." Why capitalism's left ankle specifically has never been explained; its right ankle appears to be unharmed. His mixtape [[laugh-exe|*Laugh.exe*]] "was infecting Gotham's infrastructure through bluetooth-enabled gargoyles" ([[bluetooth-gargoyles]]).

He performed "every night" at [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]] under a rotating giant Twitter X.

sections.heading: The Battle of Club Shadowban
sections.body:
When [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] arrived, Lil Jokez opened with the bar quoted above, insulting Kanye's [[propane]] and telling him to go back to [[flint|Flint]]. Kanye and GPT answered with verses from [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]], and the crowd exploded in Fortnite emotes.

Lil Jokez "screamed and morphed into a 2007 JPEG of Heath Ledger." Drake Batman then tackled him into a [[meme-portal|meme portal]]. See [[rap-battle-club-shadowban]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Heath Ledger played the Joker in *The Dark Knight* (2008), which was in production in 2007, explaining the date on the JPEG.
- The "Lil" prefix is a common rapper naming convention (compare [[lil-uzi-vert|Lil Uzi Vert]] and [[litl-wayne|Litl Wayne]]).
- Lil Jokez's dissing of propane is the only known point on which he agrees with [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]], who also found Kanye's propane "watered down".

title: Laugh.exe
subtitle: Do not run.
lead: ***Laugh.exe*** is the mixtape of [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]]. It is the only mixtape in the canon that is also an executable file. It "was infecting Gotham's infrastructure through bluetooth-enabled gargoyles."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
The mixtape is the reason [[drake-batman|Drake Batman]] asked [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] for help, and the reason Kanye answered by dropping his own mixtape, [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]]. Its track list is unknown, but given Lil Jokez's diss tracks, it likely concerns propane, ChatGPT and capitalism's left ankle.

".exe" is the file extension for Windows programs, which explains how it spreads like a virus.

title: 808s and Apocalypses
subtitle: The drop heard across all multiverses.

infobox.Effect: Opened a [[the-wormhole|wormhole]] across all multiverses at once

quote.text: The mixtape… has dropped.

lead: ***808s and Apocalypses*** is the mixtape of [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]], dropped in [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]] to counter [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]]'s [[laugh-exe|*Laugh.exe*]]. It is the only mixtape in the canon confirmed to have cosmological consequences.

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
Kanye declared: "ChatGPT, it's time to drop our mixtape." ChatGPT replied: "Yes sir. Initializing 808s and Apocalypses."

Known verses, performed at the [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|Battle of Club Shadowban]]:

> I'm Ye the Gas, no watered-down trash, My bars melt steel beams, while you still DoorDash.

> ChatGPT online, rhymes divine, I code your whole verse in assembly line.

sections.heading: The drop
sections.body:
After the battle there was silence, then: "The mixtape… has dropped." Suddenly "across all multiverses, a wormhole opened at once", out of which came the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] carrying [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], who said "Ye. GPT. I heard the drop."

This fulfils the first instruction of [[siri|Siri 3G]] at the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]]: "Begin the Mixtape." Kanye and GPT appear to have begun it without knowing about the instruction.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The title parodies Kanye West's real 2008 album *808s & Heartbreak*.
- "Ye the Gas" refers to Kanye's [[ye-the-gas|propane brand]].

title: The Battle of Club Shadowban
subtitle: Bars were dropped. So was everyone else.

infobox.Result: Lil Jokez tackled into a [[meme-portal|meme portal]]; [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] arrives

quote.text: I'm Ye the Gas, no watered-down trash, My bars melt steel beams, while you still DoorDash.

lead: **The Battle of Club Shadowban** was a rap battle between [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] on one side and [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]] on the other. It ended with no surviving clubgoers, a meme portal, and the second coming of [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]].

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: Lil Jokez had been infecting [[gotham-city|Gotham]] with [[laugh-exe|*Laugh.exe*]]. [[drake-batman|Drake Batman]] recruited Kanye, who decided to answer with his own mixtape, [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]]. The crowd that night included former presidents, TikTok influencers and the [[angry-pope|angry Pope disguised as Tyler1]].

sections.heading: The battle
sections.body:
Lil Jokez opened:

> Kanye's propane is mid, ChatGPT simps for lint, Gotham's my turf, now go back to Flint.

"Kanye's eyes glowed. GPT's speakers unfolded like mecha wings. They hit the stage." Kanye answered with the "Ye the Gas" verse, and GPT followed with "ChatGPT online, rhymes divine, I code your whole verse in assembly line."

"The crowd exploded in Fortnite emotes." Lil Jokez screamed and morphed into a 2007 JPEG of Heath Ledger. Drake Batman threw a smoke grenade filled with peach-flavored Axe body spray and tackled him into a [[meme-portal|meme portal]].

sections.heading: The drop
sections.body: "Silence. Then: 'The mixtape… has dropped.'" A [[the-wormhole|wormhole]] opened across all multiverses at once, and a glowing sideways [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] hovered down to the stage with Steve Jobs standing on top of it, "wearing a turtleneck spun from algorithms and starlight." He lifted the iPhone "like Mufasa presenting Simba", apps began downloading themselves onto flip phones across the cosmos, and "The Shadow Realm wept." He ended with "[[one-more-thing|One more thing]]... Let's end this."

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: In the next chapter the crowd had vanished, leaving dusty floors and footprints. Steve blamed the [[zuck-tears-usb|Zuck Tears USB]] and declared the club sent to the [[shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- "Steel beams" refers to the long-running "jet fuel can't melt steel beams" meme.
- No judges were present. By most readings, Kanye and GPT won by forfeit, since their opponent became a JPEG.

title: Bluetooth-Enabled Gargoyles
subtitle: Gothic architecture, wireless edition.
lead: **Bluetooth-Enabled Gargoyles** are part of [[gotham-city|Gotham City]]'s architecture. They are mentioned once, as the means by which [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]]'s mixtape [[laugh-exe|*Laugh.exe*]] "was infecting Gotham's infrastructure."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body: Why Gotham's gargoyles were Bluetooth-enabled in the first place is never explained. Fan-wiki consensus is that it was a smart-city initiative that went wrong. Gargoyles are a classic feature of Batman's Gotham in the comics and films, usually as places for him to brood rather than as file-sharing hubs.

title: The Meme Portal
subtitle: Where Jokers go when they're tackled.
lead: **The Meme Portal** is a portal in [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]] into which [[drake-batman|Drake Batman]] "tackled" [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]] at the end of the [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|Battle of Club Shadowban]]. Its arrival is not described. It is simply there when needed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- Where the portal leads is unknown. Since Lil Jokez had just become a 2007 JPEG of Heath Ledger, a meme portal is arguably his natural habitat.
- It is one of several portals and [[the-wormhole|wormholes]] in the canon. It is not to be confused with the wormhole opened moments later by [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]].

title: The Angry Pope (disguised as Tyler1)
subtitle: Holy See. Holy Tilted.
lead: **The Angry Pope** was a patron of [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], where the crowd included "former presidents, TikTok influencers, and one angry Pope disguised as Tyler1." He is never mentioned again.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- Tyler1 is a streamer famous for playing League of Legends and for his loud, angry outbursts. This makes the disguise either very good or redundant, since the Pope was already angry.
- Which Pope it was is not specified.
- Like the rest of the crowd, he vanished after the battle, leaving only footprints in the dust. He is presumed to be in the [[shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]].

title: Flint
subtitle: Destination of a diss.
lead: **Flint** is a city mentioned once in the canon, in the closing line of [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]]'s opening bar at the [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|Battle of Club Shadowban]]: "Gotham's my turf, now go back to Flint."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
The line is aimed at [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and/or [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]]. Neither has ever been shown to come from Flint, so the instruction to "go back" is lore-unsupported. Kanye is from Chicago in real life.

In the real world, Flint, Michigan is known for its water crisis. The bar comes right after an attack on Kanye's [[propane]], which [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] had separately found to be "watered down", so the canon appears to have a running theme about bad liquids.

title: The Nether Dimension
subtitle: Beta-testing grounds.
lead: **The Nether Dimension** is the dimension where [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]] "used to beta test Snapchat." He mentioned it while introducing himself to [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] in a [[gotham-city|Gotham]] alley, as part of his credentials as an App Whisperer. Nothing else about the dimension is known: not its location, its climate, or whether the beta ever shipped.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- "The Nether" is the hellish dimension in Minecraft, the home game of [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]].
- It is possibly where [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat: Ghost Protocol Edition]] was developed (**fan theory**).

title: Timeline R
subtitle: Where Vine runs backwards.
lead: **Timeline R** is a timeline where someone "made Vine loop in reverse." [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] identified [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]] as the culprit, gasping in XML. He replied: "Guilty."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- What happened to Timeline R as a result is not stated. Since [[vine|Vine]] was an app built on six-second looping videos, reversing the loop may have been a serious matter.
- "R" is often taken to stand for "Reverse". There is no canonical support for this.
- Timeline R is one of several alternate realities in the canon, alongside [[reality-42-b|Reality 42-B]] and [[universe-prime|Universe Prime]].

title: Steve Jobs
subtitle: Turtleneck of algorithms and starlight. One more thing.

quote.text: This is not a phone. This is an anti-deity protocol. This is how we stop Chris. This… is how we ball.

lead:
**Steve Jobs** is a technologist, prophet and heist leader who arrives in the canon on top of a flying [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]]. He is the mastermind behind the plan to defeat [[chris|Chris]] using legacy technology, and the only person the [[inav|Inav]] answers to.

He joins [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] after the [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|Battle of Club Shadowban]] and leads them through the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]] to recover [[verizon-contract|the 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon]].

sections.heading: Arrival at Club Shadowban
sections.body:
When [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]] dropped, a wormhole opened across all multiverses and a glowing sideways iPhone 3G flew out of it. "Standing atop it, wearing a turtleneck spun from algorithms and starlight, was Steve Jobs himself." His voice "echoed with .wav clarity."

> Ye. GPT. I heard the drop. It's time for the final collab.

He lifted the iPhone "like Mufasa presenting Simba", causing apps to download themselves onto flip phones across the cosmos, and "The Shadow Realm wept." He closed with "One more thing... Let's end this."

sections.heading: The Keynote (flashback)
sections.body: The [[flashback-chapter]] shows Steve's earlier [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]] in [[reality-42-b|Reality 42-B]], wearing "a black turtleneck woven from Mark Zuckerberg's abandoned dreams." There he unveiled the iPhone 3G as the answer to Chris, consulted [[siri|Siri 3G]], and then "ascends into a hologram labeled 'Return when Fortnite ends.'" Fortnite is not known to have ended, so his return is either early or a sign that something has happened to Fortnite.

sections.heading: Gotham and the Inav
sections.body:
Back in the present, Kanye shouted "Steve Jawbs?!" Steve explained: "I felt a disturbance in the iCloud I had to come here right away." Examining the empty [[club-shadowban|club]], he blamed the [[zuck-tears-usb|USB drive]] for sending the room to the [[shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]] and summoned the [[inav|Inav]], which he had started with [[steve-wozniak|Wozniak]] in the mid 80's for the [[department-of-awesomeness|Department of Awesomeness]]. On boarding he "parked his zyn in the zyn storage locker" ([[zyn]]).

When Gotham began disappearing, Steve offered his theory: "beat drops can't exist without balling... even young Sheldon predicted this how could Chris be so blind" ([[young-sheldon]]). He then ordered Siri to take them to the casino: "its time to liberate the gift card."

sections.heading: The Casino Heist
sections.body:
At [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99]], Steve briefed the crew that the Verizon contract "Resides here" and that getting it would start "the journey back to balling out for real for real." He led the way along the casino walls and produced his iPhone "from his Ipouch in his Ibag from his Ipocket." He noted that "Ever since Tim apple retired ive had to source all my gadgets locally.. this new kid can't be trusted.. but ill explain that later" ([[tim-apple]]). He has not explained it later.

With ChatGPT plugged in, he cut into the wall with the [[facetime-laser|Ultra Mega Uber Cool FaceTime Laser]]. Facing the [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]] guarding the lower chambers, he announced "its time to count gang violence" and incapacitated the first with his [[igun|Igun]]. After the truce with [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew, he placed an [[airtag|AirTag]] on the [[the-vault|vault]] door and said "Hey Siri.. fire the Ibeam." As the [[ibeam|Ibeam]] fired, he remarked: "Yess.. perfection, just like the iPod touch.. that thing cooked eggs while playing geometry dash" ([[ipod-touch]]).

sections.heading: The TurboGrafx problem
sections.body: Aboard the Inav, sitting in "his futuristic pilots seat on the second floor main deck", Steve laid out the next step: travel to the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 sector]] to "sync with the flip phone covenant" ([[flip-phone-covenant]]). The catch is that the covenant now uses [[5g|5G]], which would awaken [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]]'s dormant twin. His plan is to "bypass the G" and roll back to 3G "right when we need to activate it." When GPT objected, Steve said: "Its not like we have a choice GPT, its just how it'll have to go…."

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The real Steve Jobs co-founded Apple and died in 2011. "One more thing" was his famous keynote catchphrase, and the iPhone 3G was released in 2008, the same year he stopped developing the Inav.
- He is the second character to sense "a disturbance" in something, after [[rfk|RFK]] felt one in the [[protestant-universe|Protestant Universe]].

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- Kanye "shouted" Steve's name and then "was speechless".
- The chapter containing Steve's flashback is titled as being "all a flashback", but only the keynote section is one.
- Steve says he has to source gadgets locally since Tim Apple retired, but the Igun, Ibeam, AirTag and FaceTime laser are all clearly Apple products.

title: iPhone 3G
subtitle: Sideways. Cracked. Plays U2 on loop. Never update.

quote.text: A device so ancient, it predates TikTok. So stable, it survived the downfall of Vine. So pure, it connects to only one tower… and that's God's router.

lead: The **iPhone 3G** is [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s phone and the central technology of the plan to defeat [[chris|Chris]]. It is sideways, it is cracked, and it plays U2 on loop. According to Steve, "This is not a phone. This is an anti-deity protocol."

sections.heading: Description
sections.body: At the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]], the iPhone 3G descended through a portal as "a familiar glowing rectangle." "It's sideways. It's cracked. It plays U2 on loop. Everyone weeps." Steve introduced it to the "Ladies, gentlemen, wacko ballers" in attendance as predating TikTok, having survived the downfall of [[vine|Vine]], and connecting only to [[gods-router|God's router]].

sections.heading: Specifications
sections.body:
The keynote lists the following reasons "Why the iPhone 3G Matters":

- **3G Speed:** "Because 4G is for the weak, and 5G awakens Elon Mush's dormant twin." See [[5g]] and [[elon-mush]].
- **No Front Camera:** "To avoid self-reflection. Literally."
- **Sacred App Compatibility:** It is "the only phone capable of running" [[myspace|MySpace]] v1.3.3, [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat: Ghost Protocol Edition]], [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]] and [[twitter|Twitter]] Bluebird Variant (with no limits). See [[sacred-apps|The Sacred Apps]].
- **No Auto-Correct:** "You are forced to mean what you say. Even 'baller' must be typed with intention."

It also comes with [[siri|Siri 3G]], who advises: "never update".

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
The phone first appears in the present day when [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]] dropped: "Out of it flew a glowing sideways iPhone 3G, pulsing with raw nostalgia," with Steve standing on top of it. Lifted "like Mufasa presenting Simba", it caused apps to download themselves onto flip phones across the cosmos.

Afterwards Steve uses it as an all-purpose tool. He used it to examine [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], to summon the [[inav|Inav]] via Siri, as the emitter for the [[facetime-laser|FaceTime laser]] (with [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] plugged in), and to fire the [[ibeam|Ibeam]]. He keeps it in his Ipouch, in his Ibag, in his Ipocket. In the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 sector]] he began "entering the gift card code" from the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]] into it.

sections.heading: The 5G problem
sections.body: The [[flip-phone-covenant|Flip Phone Covenant]] now uses 5G, and connecting the iPhone to it risks waking Elon Mush's twin. Steve's workaround is to "bypass the G by loading a social media first" and roll back to 3G "Right when we're in Chris's face."

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The real iPhone 3G (2008) did lack a front camera. One arrived with the iPhone 4 in 2010, which makes this one of the canon's most accurate statements.
- "Plays U2 on loop" refers to Apple automatically adding a U2 album to every iTunes library in 2014.
- The [[the-prophecy|Prophecy]] does not name the iPhone. It only requires "a phone capable of containing" the Sacred Apps, [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]] 2, [[settings|Settings]] (Full access) and the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]].

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- In [[chapter-triangle|Chapter Triangle]], [[plankton|Plankton]] says the only person able to battle Chris is one who has downloaded the sacred apps onto a "[[nokia-i-4500|nokia I-4500 flip phone]] with android wireless technology." The canon has therefore named two different chosen phones, one by Nokia and one by Apple.
- Steve calls it "the only phone capable" of running the apps, yet in the same scene apps download themselves onto flip phones across the cosmos.

title: Siri (3G)
subtitle: Never update.

infobox.Functions: Prophecy, [[inav|Inav]] operation, beverage service, weapons control

quote.text: Begin the Mixtape. Sync with the Flip Phone Covenant. And remember… never update

lead: **Siri**, credited as **SIRI 3G**, is the voice assistant of the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]]. She is part oracle and part ship's computer, and is [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s most reliable crew member.

sections.heading: The prophecy
sections.body:
At the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]], with the world gone silent, Steve asked: "Hey Siri, how do we defeat Chris?" Siri gave the three-part answer quoted above. All three parts later come up:

- **Begin the Mixtape:** fulfilled when [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]] dropped.
- **Sync with the Flip Phone Covenant:** the crew's goal in the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 sector]]. See [[flip-phone-covenant]].
- **Never update:** still in force, as far as anyone knows.

sections.heading: Ship's computer
sections.body:
Siri also operates the [[inav|Inav]]:

- Steve's command "Hey Siri, locate the Inav" summoned the ship to [[gotham-city|Gotham]].
- The request "Hey Siri get me some diet dr.pepper" deployed a hovering coaster with an ice cold [[diet-dr-pepper|Diet Dr Pepper]].
- When Steve asked how Chris could be so blind, Siri answered: "The world will never know." Siri then warned: "Steve we must blip soon this city Is unstable."
- Ordered to the casino, Siri replied "Right away sir."
- On "Hey Siri.. fire the Ibeam", Siri fired the [[ibeam|Ibeam]].
- On "Take us to.. The Turbo Graphx 16 sector", Siri replied "Teleporting sir."

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Siri is Apple's real voice assistant. It debuted in 2011 on the iPhone 4S and never ran on the real iPhone 3G, so SIRI 3G is a canon-exclusive build.
- "The world will never know" is a line from an old Tootsie Pop commercial.

title: The iPhone 3G Keynote
subtitle: Good evening… or good dimension.

infobox.Casualties: One NFT collector (blinded), one MySpace server (emotional)
infobox.Ending: Stage collapses into Mountain Dew Baja Blast

quote.text: Good evening… or good dimension.

lead: **The iPhone 3G Keynote** is a product launch held by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], shown in the [[flashback-chapter|Flashback Chapter]] ("This is a Flashback"). It is the canon's main source of information on the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]], [[siri|Siri 3G]] and the [[sacred-apps|Sacred Apps]].

sections.heading: Setting
sections.body: The stated location is "Reality 42-B, Shadow-Filtered Theater, Cupertino, California, United Multiverses" ([[reality-42-b]], [[shadow-filtered-theater]]). Steve, "dressed in a black turtleneck woven from Mark Zuckerberg's abandoned dreams", stepped onto a levitating stage. "Light refracts off his glasses, bouncing into a wormhole and blinding an NFT collector in [[universe-prime|Universe Prime]]." The applause came from "both audience and sentient holograms."

sections.heading: The presentation
sections.body:
Steve spoke of "Tales of Chris— baller incarnate, god of dabs, killer of vibe stability," and of universes collapsing "from too much clout." He told the audience that "you've tried using modern tech… and you've failed." At this, "A single MySpace server cries in the back."

"But what if I told you… the answer was never in the future." The lights went out, a portal opened, and the iPhone 3G floated down, sideways, cracked and playing U2. "Everyone weeps." Steve then listed the specifications (see [[iphone-3g]]) and consulted Siri, who said: "Begin the Mixtape. Sync with the Flip Phone Covenant. And remember… never update."

sections.heading: Ending
sections.body: "The stage collapses into a pool of Mountain Dew Baja Blast. Steve ascends into a hologram labeled 'Return when Fortnite ends.'" The narrative then skips ahead: "Fast forward enough centuries for humans to do surgery on a grape."

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Apple's real headquarters are in Cupertino, California. The real iPhone 3G was announced at WWDC in June 2008.
- "They did surgery on a grape" is a 2018 meme based on a video of a surgical robot.
- The keynote is written partly as a stage script, with parenthetical stage directions.
- Mountain Dew Baja Blast is a real flavour, mainly sold at Taco Bell. See [[mountain-dew]].

title: Reality 42-B
subtitle: Keynote reality.
lead: **Reality 42-B** is the reality in which [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] held the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]]. The full address is "Reality 42-B, Shadow-Filtered Theater, Cupertino, California, United Multiverses."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The address implies that the [[multiverse|multiverse]] has been politically unified as the "United Multiverses", which contrasts with the [[multiverse-civil-war|Multiverse Civil War]] of the origin story.
- 42 is famously "the answer to life, the universe and everything" in *The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy*. Whether a Reality 42-A exists is unknown.

title: Shadow-Filtered Theater, Cupertino
subtitle: Levitating stage. Collapsible into soda.

infobox.Status: Collapsed into Mountain Dew Baja Blast

lead: **The Shadow-Filtered Theater** in Cupertino, California, [[reality-42-b|Reality 42-B]], was the venue of [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]]. It had a levitating stage, an audience of people and sentient holograms, and at least one MySpace server, which cried.

sections.heading: Fate
sections.body:
At the end of the keynote, "The stage collapses into a pool of Mountain Dew Baja Blast." It is unclear whether the rest of the theater survived.

The name suggests it filters shadows. Given how often things in the canon are sent to the [[shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]], this may have been a sensible safety feature.

title: Universe Prime
subtitle: Home of one (formerly sighted) NFT collector.
lead: **Universe Prime** is mentioned exactly once. At the start of the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]], light refracting off [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s glasses bounced "into a wormhole and blinding an NFT collector in Universe Prime."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- It is unknown whether the NFT collector recovered, or whether the wormhole was put there for this purpose.
- Despite its name, there is no evidence that Universe Prime is the main universe of the [[multiverse|multiverse]]. Zuckerberg's "fav" universe, the only one spared by [[the-snap|the Snap]], is a stronger candidate.
- See also [[nfts|NFTs]].

title: The Flip Phone Covenant
subtitle: Sync with it. Carefully.

quote.text: Begin the Mixtape. Sync with the Flip Phone Covenant. And remember… never update

lead: **The Flip Phone Covenant** is an organisation (or possibly a network) with which the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] must sync in order to defeat [[chris|Chris]], according to [[siri|Siri 3G]] at the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]].

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body:
After the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] took the [[inav|Inav]] to the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 sector]]: "We gotta sync with the flip phone covenant, and then we start with the social media apps.."

The problem: "the current flip phone covenant uses 5g, and if we connect the iPhone to that.." This would wake [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]]'s dormant twin (see [[5g]]). Steve's plan is to bypass the G and roll back to 3G at the last moment. [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] warned that this means dealing with Elon at the same time as Chris.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The word "current" implies that there have been earlier covenants, presumably using older networks.
- When Steve lifted the iPhone in [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], "Apps began downloading themselves onto flip phones across the cosmos", which may have been the covenant's first contact.
- A Covenant using 5G is, by Siri's own logic, already updated, which arguably breaks the "never update" rule.
- Flip phones also appear in [[chapter-triangle|Chapter Triangle]] as the [[nokia-i-4500|Nokia I-4500]].

title: God's Router
subtitle: One tower. Full bars.

quote.text: So pure, it connects to only one tower… and that's God's router.

lead: **God's Router** is the only tower the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] connects to, according to [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] at the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]]. It is mentioned once.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- Steve calls it both a "tower" and a "router" in the same sentence, so it may be both.
- Its location, password and data plan are unknown. The [[verizon-contract|3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon]] may or may not cover it.
- The iPhone is called "an anti-deity protocol", which makes it odd that it connects only to God's router. Fan-wiki consensus does not explain this.

title: The Sacred Apps
subtitle: The canonical app store of destiny.
lead: **The Sacred Apps** are the legacy social media applications that must be installed on a single phone in order to defeat [[chris|Chris]]. They are the canon's version of the Infinity Stones, and like them they must be collected.

sections.heading: List
sections.body:
At the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] lists the four apps the iPhone 3G is uniquely able to run:

- [[myspace|MySpace]] v1.3.3
- [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat: Ghost Protocol Edition]]
- [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]]
- [[twitter|Twitter]] Bluebird Variant (with no limits)

[[the-prophecy|The Prophecy]], told by [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]], repeats these four and adds:

- [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]] 2
- [[settings|Settings]] (Full access)

It also requires [[verizon-contract|The 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text]], which is a contract rather than an app.

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
The idea goes back to the origin story ([[chapter-before-chapter-2|Chris Origins]]), in which Chris balled into the sky "to learn about the secret teachings of twitter, myspace, instagram, snapchat and, facebook" ([[social-media-teachings]]). Those teachings produced Apple Podcasts, and [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]]'s anti-social media platform became Settings.

In [[chapter-triangle|Chapter Triangle]], [[plankton|Plankton]] says that the only person who can battle Chris is one who "has met with the tech bros and has downloaded the sacred social media apps onto there nokia I-4500 flip phone."

sections.heading: Known locations
sections.body:
- Facebook (Pre-Cringe) is held in the [[projects-national-archives|Projects National Archives]] on a [[microsd-card|67gb micro sd card]].
- The others are unaccounted for. Steve's plan to "start with the social media apps" after syncing with the [[flip-phone-covenant|Flip Phone Covenant]] suggests a hunt is coming.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Instagram is one of the original secret teachings but is missing from both later lists.
- "Bluebird" refers to Twitter's bird logo, retired in the 2023 rebrand to X.
- "Apple Podcasts 2" implies an Apple Podcasts 1. The origin story's Apple Podcasts was a social media platform founded by Chris, LeBron, Elon and Zuckerberg.

title: Snapchat: Ghost Protocol Edition
subtitle: Should you choose to accept it.
lead: **Snapchat: Ghost Protocol Edition** is one of the [[sacred-apps|Sacred Apps]]. It is listed at the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]] as one of the apps only the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] can run, and again in [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]].

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- *Mission: Impossible – Ghost Protocol* is a 2011 film. Snapchat's logo is a ghost.
- [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]] "used to beta test Snapchat in the nether dimension", so he is the canon's leading Snapchat expert. Whether he tested this edition is unknown.
- Snapchat was one of the "secret teachings" in the origin story ([[social-media-teachings]]).

title: Facebook (Pre-Cringe)
subtitle: Prize possession of the Projects. Stored on 67 GB of hope.

quote.text: Computah locate Facebook…
quote.by: The final line of the canon, [[chapter-4-point-1]]

lead: **Facebook (Pre-Cringe)** is one of the [[sacred-apps|Sacred Apps]] needed to defeat [[chris|Chris]]. It is the only one whose physical location is known, and its recovery is the cliffhanger on which the canon ends.

sections.heading: History
sections.body: Facebook was among the "secret teachings" Chris learned in the origin story ([[social-media-teachings]]). The Pre-Cringe edition was listed at the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]] as one of the apps only the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] can run, and in [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]].

sections.heading: In the Projects
sections.body:
After MF Vroom recited the Prophecy, he and [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]] revealed:

> We have Facebook (Pre-Cringe) in the national archives.. Its been one of our prize possessions since the nations inception, we're not quite sure how it got here, but under a build building, in the rubble we found it on a 67gb micro sd card.

The crew concluded that this is why [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama]] deployed [[ton-618|TON 618]] against them: "If he knows our end goal already and he has connections with Chris.. That has to be why." [[rfk|RFK]] proposed that, instead of retaking [[the-projects|the Projects]], they "just try to just get Facebook." Someone pointed out that "The ssd would still be in the palace."

[[plankton|Plankton]] said "Aight bet", their course was set, and the book ends: "Computah locate Facebook…"

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- It is stored on a "67gb micro sd card", then a few lines later on "The ssd". These are different kinds of storage.
- It is in the "national archives" and then "in the palace". These may be the same building.
- 67 GB is not a standard micro SD capacity. 67 is a recurring number in the canon (see [[the-67-casino|the 6 7 Casino]]).

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- "Pre-Cringe" implies that Facebook later became cringe. Neither the timing nor the cause is given.
- "Computah" mirrors Steve Jobs's habit of saying "Hey Siri". It is unknown which computer is being addressed.

title: The Inav
subtitle: A multiverse navigator that just works.

infobox.Exterior: Vertical pill, white with teal-tinted glass shell, Apple logo
infobox.Interior: Mansion (exterior is the size of a phone booth)

quote.text: Welcome to Inav, a multiverse navigator that just works.

lead: **The Inav** is a universal navigator and transporter for the [[multiverse|multiverse]], built by Apple. Only one exists, and it answers only to [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]. It is the main vehicle of Steve, [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] from [[gotham-city|Gotham]] onward.

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
Asked by ChatGPT (who wanted to add it to its "GitHub respiratory"), Steve explained:

> the Inav was a project I started with Wozniak in the mid 80's, its why we hit our slump, the Inav was out biggest project yet, working with the Department of Awesomeness (DOA) we were contracted to create universal navigator and transporter for the newly found multiverse

The [[department-of-awesomeness|DOA]] never used it: "they were dissolved the same day they asked for it." Apple, "knowing our capabilities", kept developing it anyway "until 2008". "Only one article exists.. and that one only answers to me."

sections.heading: Design
sections.body:
The Inav appeared "flying through the sky" as "a vertical pill shaped object. White with a glass outer shell tinted in teal and a apple logo centered in the front." It hovers. On landing it "rotated 180 degrees and opened its back door like a hull wing door."

Inside is a foyer with a **zyn storage locker**, where Steve parks his [[zyn]]. The interior is "like a mansion", although "the exterior was as big as a phone booth." Refreshments are served from the wall: on request, "a hovering coaster was deployed from the wall servicing Kanye a ice cold [[diet-dr-pepper|diet dr.pepper]]." The bridge is on the "second floor main deck", where Steve has a "futuristic pilots seat" that spins.

Its "white glassy exterior" is bulletproof: the casino's protection system fired on it and the bullets bounced off.

sections.heading: Capabilities
sections.body:
- **Multiverse travel:** the Inav flies into self-opening [[the-wormhole|wormholes]]. The tunnel is lined with "Doritos and mountain dew ads, xbox live cod clip comps and skrilla." It exits through "A giant rift" in the sky.
- **Teleportation:** on command, Siri responds "Teleporting sir."
- **Remote targeting:** it can lock onto an [[airtag|AirTag]] and fire the [[ibeam|Ibeam]], which first needs an EMP.
- **Reconnaissance:** at the casino it circled the roof "to get a 360 view of the building."
- **Boarding:** it can pull up to a hole in a building and lower a ladder.

sections.heading: Journeys
sections.body:
- [[gotham-city|Gotham City]] to [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99]] and [[the-67-casino|the casino]] ([[flashback-chapter]], [[chapter-maybe-seventh]]).
- Escape from the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]] with [[verizon-contract|the Verizon contract]] on board.
- The casino to the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 sector]], to sync with the [[flip-phone-covenant|Flip Phone Covenant]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Being bigger on the inside than on the outside, and the size of a phone booth, the Inav is widely compared to the TARDIS from *Doctor Who*.
- "Just works" was a well-known Apple marketing slogan.
- In real life, Jobs left Apple in 1985, the mid 80's. The canon blames the slump on the Inav.
- 2008, the year development ended, is also the year the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] was released.
- **Fan theory:** the iPad (2010) is a failed attempt at a second Inav.

title: Steve Wozniak
subtitle: The other Steve.
lead: **Steve Wozniak** is mentioned once, by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]: "the Inav was a project I started with Wozniak in the mid 80's, its why we hit our slump." He co-started the [[inav|Inav]], the multiverse navigator commissioned by the [[department-of-awesomeness|Department of Awesomeness]].

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The real Steve Wozniak co-founded Apple with Jobs in 1976 and designed the Apple I and II.
- Since Jobs continued developing the Inav until 2008 and it "only answers to me", Wozniak seems to have had no lasting access to the project. His current whereabouts are unknown.

title: Department of Awesomeness (DOA)
subtitle: Commissioned the Inav. Dissolved immediately.

infobox.Lifespan: Ended the same day it asked for the Inav

lead: The **Department of Awesomeness (DOA)** is the organisation that contracted Apple to create a "universal navigator and transporter for the newly found multiverse" in the mid 80's. It produced the [[inav|Inav]] and then had no use for it, since "they were dissolved the same day they asked for it."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- Its abbreviation, DOA, also stands for "dead on arrival". This turned out to be an accurate description.
- It should not be confused with the [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense (DOD)]], an army split between [[jeff-bezosi|Jeff Bezosi]] and Mark Zucc that hunts [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] in [[chapter-the-fourth|Chapter the Fourth]].
- The phrase "newly found multiverse" suggests the multiverse was discovered in the mid 80's. In the origin story, however, [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] created it at the dawn of time to remake "Spider-man Across the spider verse."

title: Tim Apple
subtitle: Retired. Successor untrustworthy.

quote.text: Ever since Tim apple retired ive had to source all my gadgets locally.. this new kid can't be trusted.. but ill explain that later.

lead: **Tim Apple** is mentioned once, by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] during the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]]. His retirement has forced Steve to "source all my gadgets locally", and his successor ("this new kid") "can't be trusted".

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- "Tim Apple" is a real nickname for Apple CEO Tim Cook, from a 2019 slip of the tongue by Donald Trump.
- Steve promised to "explain that later". As of the end of the canon he has not, which makes the "new kid" one of the canon's open mysteries.
- Despite the local sourcing, the gadget Steve pulls out immediately afterwards is an iPhone (see [[facetime-laser]]).

title: Young Sheldon
subtitle: Called it.

infobox.Known for: Predicting that beat drops can't exist without balling

quote.text: Its as I thought, beat drops can't exist without balling, it a natural evolution of hip-hop vibing.. even young Sheldon predicted this how could Chris be so blind

lead: **Young Sheldon** is mentioned once, by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], as having predicted that "beat drops can't exist without balling." Steve cited the prediction to explain why [[gotham-city|Gotham City]] was disappearing.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- *Young Sheldon* is a sitcom about the childhood of Sheldon Cooper from *The Big Bang Theory*. It is not known to have made any predictions about hip-hop.
- When Steve asked how Chris could be so blind, [[siri|Siri]] answered: "The world will never know."
- See also [[balling]].

title: The Igun
subtitle: Apple's take on sidearms.
lead: **The Igun** is a weapon used during the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]]. When the crew came upon 3-4 [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]] guarding the lower chambers of [[the-67-casino|the casino]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] announced "its time to count gang violence", leapt at the first one with his Igun and incapacitated him. The text specifies 37 shots.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- [[kanye-west|Kanye]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] incapacitated the other two "with their newly acquired Iguns." When and where they acquired them is never shown. Since ChatGPT has no stated hands, how it holds one is also unclear.
- The count of "3-4" Kirks followed by "the other two" leaves the fate of the possible fourth Kirk unresolved.
- Part of Apple's "i" product line in the canon, alongside the [[ibeam|Ibeam]], [[inav|Inav]] and Ipouch/Ibag/Ipocket.

title: The Ibeam
subtitle: EMP first. Haircut second. Vault third.

infobox.Side effects: Area-wide EMP; low taper fade on [[dj-khaled|DJ Khaled]]

quote.text: The.. Ibeam needs to use a emp to get rid of any excess energy in the area.. just stay where you are

lead: **The Ibeam** is the [[inav|Inav]]'s main weapon. It is a giant beam that fires at whatever an [[airtag|AirTag]] is stuck to. It was used to open [[the-vault|the vault]] holding [[verizon-contract|the 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon]] during the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]].

sections.heading: The firing
sections.body:
[[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] said that nothing his crew had could open the vault. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] smirked, said "Behold," and produced an AirTag: "Once I place this onto the vault door then the Inav outside will be able to lock onto it, and fire the Ibeam."

After placing the tag and telling everyone to stand back, Steve said "Hey Siri.. fire the Ibeam." The whole building went silent: lights shut off, generators stopped, and the floor went dark, as the Ibeam's EMP cleared the area. Then came "a giant flash" in which "a huge massive low taper fade got put on DJ KALED", and "a enormous beam shot through the building onto to the vault door."

Steve, light shining off his glasses, said: "Yess.. perfection, just like the iPod touch.. that thing cooked eggs while playing geometry dash" ([[ipod-touch]]). After a few seconds the beam turned off, leaving a fog of dust and a hole large enough for moonlight to come in.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The low taper fade is a haircut, and a 2024 meme. Why the Ibeam gives haircuts is unexplained. [[dj-khaled|DJ Khaled]] is its only known recipient.
- The beam made a hole so large that the Inav later pulled up to "the massive hole made by the hole" (sic) to pick up the crew.

title: The AirTag
subtitle: Targeting beacon. Not for luggage.
lead: **The AirTag** is a small tracker that [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] took "from his pocket" during the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]] and placed on [[the-vault|the vault]] door, so that the [[inav|Inav]] outside could lock onto it and fire the [[ibeam|Ibeam]].

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- Real AirTags are Apple's item trackers, released in 2021, and are normally used to find keys. This is the first recorded use of one as a missile designator.
- Its fate after the Ibeam hit the door it was attached to is not recorded. It is presumed destroyed, or very well tracked.
- It came from Steve's "pocket", not his Ipocket. The difference is unexplained.

title: The Ultra Mega Uber Cool FaceTime Laser
subtitle: Ultra. Mega. Uber. Cool.

infobox.Full name: The Ultra Mega Uber Cool FaceTime Laser
infobox.Used on: Pale beige brick wall of [[the-67-casino|the casino]]

lead: **The Ultra Mega Uber Cool FaceTime Laser** is a laser emitted from [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s phone. Steve asked: "Chat gpt can you plug into my iPhone and turn on the ultra mega uber cool FaceTime laser?" When [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] plugged in, "a huge laser shot out from Steve Jobs's phone and started slowly cutting a entrance into the pale beige brick making up the casino's walls." The cut-out section fell away, and the crew entered the casino at the start of the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]].

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- FaceTime is Apple's video calling app. The real iPhone 3G could not run FaceTime and has no front camera (per the [[iphone-keynote|keynote]]: "To avoid self-reflection"), which makes the laser even more impressive.
- Steve introduced it right after complaining about sourcing gadgets locally since [[tim-apple|Tim Apple]] retired.

title: Zyn
subtitle: Has its own locker.
lead: **Zyn** is a brand of nicotine pouch that turns up three times in the canon, most notably in its own dedicated locker aboard the [[inav|Inav]].

sections.heading: Appearances in the canon
sections.body:
- On boarding the [[inav|Inav]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] "parked his zyn in the zyn storage locker in the foyer." The Inav is the only vehicle in the canon with dedicated Zyn storage.
- [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] came out of the port-a-potty with "2 mountain dews and a pack of zyns" from the [[quick-check|quick-check]] ([[port-a-potty-portal]]).
- [[plankton|Plankton]] yelled "Bro lowkey why r u built like a 2008 Honda accord Zyn weed addition" as the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]] took off. It is unclear whether this was aimed at [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] (a car) or the ship.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The verb "parked" suggests Steve's zyn may be a vehicle, or very large.
- The "2008 Honda accord" adds to the canon's long list of named cars. See [[toyota-corolla|The Toyota Corolla Question]] and [[honda-accord-2005|Son's 2005 Honda Accord]].

title: Diet Dr Pepper
subtitle: Dayum, this is ice cold.

quote.text: dayum this is ice cold bruh

lead: **Diet Dr Pepper** is served on board the [[inav|Inav]]. In response to "Hey Siri get me some diet dr.pepper", "a hovering coaster was deployed from the wall servicing Kanye a ice cold diet dr.pepper." [[kanye-west|Kanye]] reviewed it favourably. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] replied: "Apple only does things right kanye."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- This is the only time the Inav's beverage system is used, and it is the canon's main evidence for Steve's claim that the Inav "just works".
- Diet Dr Pepper joins [[mountain-dew|Mountain Dew]], [[red-bull|Red Bull]], [[g-fuel|G Fuel]] and [[prime|Prime]] in the canon's very caffeinated drinks list.

title: The iPod Touch
subtitle: Cooked eggs. Played Geometry Dash. Simultaneously.

infobox.Known feats: Cooking eggs while playing Geometry Dash

quote.text: Yess.. perfection, just like the iPod touch.. that thing cooked eggs while playing geometry dash

lead: **The iPod Touch** is mentioned once, by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], as the [[ibeam|Ibeam]] burned through [[the-vault|the vault]] door. He compared the beam to the iPod Touch, which "cooked eggs while playing geometry dash."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The iPod Touch was a real Apple device (2007-2022). Its tendency to get hot during games is well documented. Egg-cooking ability is not.
- Geometry Dash is a rhythm platformer mobile game.
- The comparison suggests the Ibeam and the iPod Touch share a heat-management philosophy.

title: The TurboGrafx 16 Sector
subtitle: Sixteen bits of destiny.
lead: **The TurboGrafx 16 Sector** (spelled "Turbo Graphx 16" in the text) is where the [[inav|Inav]] went after the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]]. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] ordered: "Hey Siri... Take us to.. The Turbo Graphx 16 sector." [[siri|Siri]] replied "Teleporting sir," and the Inav entered it "with a rumble and a high frequency siren."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- A crew member, usually taken to be [[kanye-west|Kanye]], asked "Why 16 Steve? I haven't been there in years." Steve explained that they had to sync with the [[flip-phone-covenant|Flip Phone Covenant]], which now uses [[5g|5G]].
- The TurboGrafx-16 was a real 1980s video game console from NEC and Hudson Soft, which fits the canon's preference for legacy technology.
- The sector is the last known location of Steve, Kanye and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] at the end of the canon.

title: 5G
subtitle: Awakens the twin.

quote.text: 3G Speed: Because 4G is for the weak, and 5G awakens Elon Mush's dormant twin.

lead: **5G** is a mobile network standard and, according to the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]], a threat to all of existence, because it awakens [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]]'s dormant twin. This is the official reason the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] runs at 3G.

sections.heading: The Covenant problem
sections.body:
In the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 sector]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] revealed that "the current flip phone covenant uses 5g, and if we connect the iPhone to that.." Someone finished: "Elon mush.. yeah that no good boy."

Steve's plan is to "bypass the G by loading a social media first, we'd have to roll back to 3G but we could do that right when we need to activate it." That would be "Right when we're in Chris's face." [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] disagreed: "If we do that then we have to deal with elon when we deal with chris, if hes coming straight from the shadow realm then who know what he'll want." Steve: "Its not like we have a choice GPT."

sections.heading: Continuity notes
sections.body:
- Elon Mush died of [[nfl-poisoning|NFL poisoning]] in the origin story. The keynote's "dormant twin" may get around this, but GPT talks about "elon" coming from the [[shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]], which raises the question of which Elon is meant.
- 4G is dismissed as "for the weak" and plays no further part.

title: "One More Thing"
subtitle: Let's end this.

infobox.Speaker: [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]
infobox.Context: End of [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|The Battle of Club Shadowban]]

quote.text: One more thing… Let's end this.

lead: **"One More Thing"** is [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s line at the end of his arrival in [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]]. After he lifted the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]], apps downloaded themselves across the cosmos and the Shadow Realm wept. Then: "'One more thing,' he said. 'Let's end this.'" It closes the [[dunder-mifflan-chapter|Dunder Mifflan]] chapter.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The real Steve Jobs used "One more thing..." at Apple keynotes to introduce a surprise final product.
- In this case the "one more thing" is not a product but a declaration of war on [[chris|Chris]], which may make it the most important "one more thing" ever said.
- Fans note that the next chapter is a flashback, so "Let's end this" is followed straight away by going back in time.

title: Vine
subtitle: Six seconds. Forwards or backwards.
lead: **Vine** is a video app mentioned twice in the canon, once as a crime scene and once as a benchmark of stability.

sections.heading: Appearances in the canon
sections.body:
- [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] recognised [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]] as "the one who made Vine loop in reverse in Timeline R" ([[timeline-r]]). He said: "Guilty."
- At the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] praised the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] as "So stable, it survived the downfall of Vine."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- Vine was a real app for six-second looping videos. It was shut down in 2017, and many still mourn it.
- The keynote calls it a "downfall", which may refer to the shutdown, or **(fan theory)** to the reverse-loop incident in Timeline R.
- Vine is not one of the [[sacred-apps|Sacred Apps]].
